```{r}
source("config.R") # the profile P (plan section 4); it does not use the RNG
set.seed(P$r$seed)
library(data.table)
library(imager)
library(parallel)
library(doParallel)
library(splines)
library(spam)
library(Matrix)
library(lme4)
library(rgl)
library(fields)
library(survival)  # Needed for CML_MODEL (clogit)
library(smoothie)


# The map is drawn in the prototype frame (P$prototype: the OLD prototype grid
# and mask for both datasets, A-006), not in the data frame of the dataset
col_proto <- P$prototype$col_shoe # the number of columns of the prototype
row_proto <- P$prototype$row_shoe # the number of rows of the prototype
proto_rel_col_shoe <- P$prototype$coords$rel_col_shoe
proto_rel_Y_cord <- P$prototype$coords$rel_Y_cord
```

```{r}

# MODEL_FEATURE comes from RAC_MODEL_FEATURE (config.R):
# NEW_X_NS_XY (default) or CML_MODEL

# The figure this run writes, checked before anything is computed: an OLD
# run in place stops here, never over a committed OLD figure (A-075)
map_pdf <- rac_new_output(P, rac_image_path(P, paste(MODEL_FEATURE, "_SHOE", sep = "")))

```




```{r }
file_name <- rac_model_path(P, MODEL_FEATURE)
rand <- readRDS(file = file_name)

# Always load the Random model to get sigma_sq and mean for calibration
random_model <- readRDS(file = rac_model_path(P, "NEW_X_NS_XY"))
sigma_sq <- as.numeric(attr(VarCorr(random_model)$shoe, "stddev"))^2

file_name <- rac_path(P, "dataCC_distance")
dataCC <- read.csv(file_name, header = TRUE)

xcoor <- t(matrix(rep((-col_proto / 2 + 1:col_proto) * proto_rel_Y_cord / proto_rel_col_shoe, row_proto), col_proto, row_proto))
ycoor <- -matrix(rep((-row_proto / 2 + 1:row_proto) * proto_rel_Y_cord / proto_rel_col_shoe, col_proto), row_proto, col_proto)
xy <- expand.grid(xcoor[1, ], ycoor[, 1]) #col_proto * row_proto
colnames(xy)[colnames(xy) == "Var1"] <- "x"
colnames(xy)[colnames(xy) == "Var2"] <- "y"
img <- load.image(rac_path(P, "prototype_mask")) #prototype
img <- t(as.matrix(img))

```


```{r }

# Build design matrix (same spline basis for both models: new_x and y)
nknotsx <- 3
nknotsy <- 5
knots_new_x <- as.numeric(quantile(dataCC$new_x,1:nknotsx/(1+nknotsx)))
knotsy <-as.numeric(quantile(dataCC$y,1:nknotsy/(1+nknotsy)))
bas_new_x <- ns(dataCC$new_x,knots=knots_new_x)
basy <- ns(dataCC$y,knots=knotsy)

newdesignmat <- rep(1,length(xy$x))
for(i in 1:length(predict(basy,1))) {
  for(j in 1:length(predict(bas_new_x,1))) {
    newdesignmat <-  cbind(newdesignmat,predict(bas_new_x, xy$x)[,j]*predict(basy, xy$y)[,i])  } }

img_filled <- t(as.matrix(load.image(rac_path(P, "prototype_mask"))))

# Compute Random model mean (needed for CML mean adjustment)
pred_random <- newdesignmat %*% fixef(random_model) + MEAN_OFFSET
pred_random[t(img_filled)==0] <- NA
m <- mean(pred_random, na.rm=TRUE)

# Compute predictions for the selected model
if(MODEL_FEATURE == 'CML_MODEL'){
  model_coef <- c(0, coef(rand))
  pred.case_control <- newdesignmat %*% model_coef
  pred.case_control[t(img_filled)==0] <- NA
  # Mean adjustment: shift CML mean to match Random model mean
  m_1 <- mean(pred.case_control, na.rm=TRUE)
  pred.case_control <- pred.case_control - m_1 + m
} else if(MODEL_FEATURE == 'NEW_X_NS_XY'){
  model_coef <- fixef(rand)
  pred.case_control <- newdesignmat %*% model_coef + MEAN_OFFSET
  pred.case_control[t(img_filled)==0] <- NA
} else { stop("Invalid MODEL_FEATURE value. Use 'NEW_X_NS_XY' or 'CML_MODEL'.")}

# Clean up variables
rm(newdesignmat, rand, random_model, dataCC, pred_random)
if(exists("bas_new_x")) rm(bas_new_x)
if(exists("basy")) rm(basy)

```


```{r }
pred.case_control_img<-pred.case_control
prob.pred <- exp(matrix(pred.case_control_img ,row_proto,col_proto,byrow=1))/(1+exp(matrix(pred.case_control_img ,row_proto,col_proto,byrow=1)))
intens <- -log(1-prob.pred) #turning it to intensity
# Scale to marginal probability: exp(-sigma^2/2) converts from conditional to marginal
intens <- intens * exp(-sigma_sq/2)
old_matrix <- intens

```

```{r }
intens[img==0] <- NA
rotated_intens <- t(intens)[, nrow(intens):1]
image.plot(rotated_intens, axes = TRUE)
pdf(file = map_pdf, height = 6, width = 6)
image.plot(rotated_intens, axes = TRUE)
abline(v = 0.5, col = "black", lty = 1, lwd = 1)
abline(h = 0.5, col = "black", lty = 1, lwd = 1)
grid(nx = 10, ny = 10, col = "gray30", lty = "dotted")
dev.off()

```
